context: This criteria evaluates correct implementation of the checkout order submission API route using @vercel/commerce-commercejs. It assesses the three-step checkout flow: token generation from cart, shipping options retrieval, and order capture with normalized payment and address data.

checklist.name: Checkout token generation
checklist.description: A checkout token is generated from the cart using the cart ID, with 'cart' specified as the token source type via checkout.generateTokenFrom()

checklist.name: Shipping options retrieval
checklist.description: Available shipping options are fetched using the generated checkout token with a country filter (US country code) via checkout.getShippingOptions()

checklist.name: Order capture
checklist.description: The order is captured using the checkout token, the first available shipping option, and the card/address data via checkout.capture()

checklist.name: Payment data normalization
checklist.description: The card data is normalized into the Commerce.js checkout capture format using the normalizeTestCheckout utility, mapping card number, expiry, and CVC fields
